title: Structural Chain-of-Thought: Reasoning with Executable Computational Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.15107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting enables reasoning in large language models but produces explanations that are difficult to verify, expensive to generate, and not always faithful. We introduce a Structural Chain-of-Thought framework where models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form reasoning. The final answer is obtained by deterministically executing the graph. The model is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning that rewards structural validity, answer correctness, and node overlap with reference graphs.   Experiments across five benchmarks and four model families show that our method consistently improves accuracy over supervised graph training and can reduce generation length by up to 5-6x compared with standard GRPO and chain-of-thought supervised training. translated_title: 结构化思维链：基于可执行计算图的推理
translated_abstract: 思维链提示使大语言模型能够进行推理，但其产生的解释难以验证、生成成本高昂，且并不总是忠实的。我们提出了一个结构化思维链框架，在该框架中，模型生成可执行的计算图来代替自由形式的推理文本。最终答案通过对该计算图进行确定性执行来获得。模型采用基于图的强化学习进行训练，奖励信号包括结构有效性、答案正确性以及与参考图的节点重合度。在五个基准测试和四个模型家族上的实验表明，与监督图训练相比，我们的方法持续提升了准确率；与标准GRPO和思维链监督训练相比，生成长度最多可缩短5-6倍。我们的忠实性实验揭示，用该方法训练的模型倾向于依靠从生成的计算图中推导出答案，而不是……
tldr: 提出结构化思维链框架，让模型生成可执行计算图并通过确定性执行得到答案，结合基于图的强化学习训练，在五个基准上提升准确率并将生成长度最多缩短5-6倍。
